CODE
Art. 2.3.75. 
Time limit for payment 
If immediate payment of the participation claim unfairly penalizes the debtor, in particular by obliging him to dispose of an asset constituting his means of subsistence, the court may, at his request, grant him time limits for payment of the claim.
A claim for which payment is deferred shall bear interest.
The court may, at the request of the creditor, require the debtor to provide security, the nature and amount of which it shall determine in equity.
